v2-1768570139518-wodfoikb9.name: Whispering Pines National Park
v2-1768570139518-wodfoikb9.description: A vast national park characterized by dense pine forests, serene lakes, and picturesque mountain vistas.

v2-1768570139519-dzd85q7jr.name: Lake Serenity Campsite
v2-1768570139519-dzd85q7jr.description: A tranquil lakeside camping site nestled within the dense pine forest, offering stunning views of the lake and mountains.

v2-1768570139519-6q5dhgz4h.name: Campsite Clearing
v2-1768570139519-6q5dhgz4h.description: A grassy clearing within the pine forest, featuring a white and grey camper van, a stone fire pit with a bright orange flame, Adirondack chairs, a dining table laden with food, and string lights strung between the trees.

colorAndLight: soft, warm glow from string lights
warm interior glow from camper van

v2-1768570387855-jtpuqisi1.name: Campsite Caravan
v2-1768570387855-jtpuqisi1.description: A cozy and inviting camper van situated in a picturesque campsite clearing. It serves as a comfortable and self-contained accommodation amidst nature.
forbiddenTransformations: Transforming the caravan into a boat.
Changing the primary color scheme to dark or monochrome.
Removing the windows or making them opaque.
Adding signs of disrepair or decay.
Making the caravan appear significantly larger than it is.
Adding visible mechanical parts or engines on the exterior.

v2-1768570387855-ki1asiyx9.name: Caravan Interior
v2-1768570387855-ki1asiyx9.description: The interior of the camper van is a warm and inviting space, featuring compact living quarters. You can see a small kitchenette area, comfortable seating, and sleeping arrangements, all bathed in the soft, ambient light from the exterior string lights and the camper's internal glow.
forbiddenTransformations: Making the interior feel cavernous or like a large hall.
Introducing modern or minimalist design aesthetics that clash with cozy.
Replacing wood paneling with metallic or plastic surfaces.
Adding bright, harsh, or cold-toned lighting.
Displaying visible cooking equipment or appliances that are not compact.
Removing the sense of enclosure and making it feel open to the outside.
Adding elements that suggest a workshop or industrial space.
Showing the user's character model in a way that breaks the scale of the interior.

v2-1768570444674-flksn2ybv.name: The Table Setting
v2-1768570444674-flksn2ybv.description: View: Detailed view of the food laid out on the table, plates, cutlery, glasses, and any decorative elements, focusing on texture and arrangement.
